reason: Although the subject reads like a refactor, it touches a very central planner primitive (`PhysicalTableReader`) and fans out across optimizer, plan costing, plan cache, explain/encoding, task building, and executor/MPP wiring. That is broad planner/executor surface area, not a narrow local cleanup, and this kind of cross-cutting move can hide high-severity regressions in planning/execution correctness even if the intent is structural.
